IN PHOTOS | The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and the Australian Defence Force (ADF) formally wrapped up Exercise ALON 2025 on Friday, August 29, marking two weeks of joint military and humanitarian activities aimed at strengthening defense cooperation and regional security.

Running from August 15 to 29, the joint exercise was staged in Palawan, Nueva Ecija, and the West Philippine Sea. It featured amphibious operations, naval and air interoperability drills, maritime security missions, and combined live-fire training. Humanitarian assistance, disaster response operations, and community outreach programs were also integrated, underscoring the AFP and ADF’s broader approach to security cooperation. | via Rex Espiritu 

📷 AFP

For more news updates, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
